title: Argentinian Chorizo Salad
description: A flavorful and textured salad featuring spicy Argentinian chorizo, wholesome greens, crunchy vegetables, and a tangy dressing.

ingredients.name: Argentinian chorizo
ingredients.notes: Choose a chorizo with a spicy kick

ingredients.name: wholesome greens
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of lettuce, spinach, and arugula

ingredients.name: crunchy vegetables
ingredients.notes: Bell peppers, carrots, and red onions work well

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Arrange the chorizo slices on the baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped greens, diced vegetables, and crispy chorizo.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
